warmup: One 12-gesture run for each fixture and each build before the fixed cohort, so both transcripts are cached. Retain every warmup separately.
steadyWindow: 200ms after finger-down through 200ms before finger-up; exclude idle gaps.
percentiles: Nearest rank; p50, p95, p99, p99.9 and maximum.
memoryScope: VmHWM is process high-water RSS through the end of the phase, including startup and opening. Retained RSS/heap follow two GCs outside the measured interval.
stoppingRule: Exactly three qualification runs per build and fixture. Preserve every run and outlier. Stop on invalid input or process failure; do not extend the cohort to obtain a passing result.
publicationGate: Only create a feature PR with demonstrated correctness/performance gains and no measured regression, including tail latency.
environment: Fresh GitHub-hosted Ubuntu x64 VM, Android 35 x86_64 emulator, 1080x2400 at 440dpi, 2GB guest RAM, two vCPUs, SwiftShader GLES, 60Hz. Emulator results do not establish physical-phone performance.
controls: Same SDK, lock resolution, fixture, emulator and input for both builds. Build and test before booting the emulator. No tracing, CPU profiler, recording or compilation during the timed phases.
data: Only freshly invented shapes and tiles. No account exports, private chats or instance data.
